title: Creamy Sandwich Spread
description: Sandwich spread, that creamy, sweet and tangy spread that's a light pink color and full of sweet pickle relish, can be hard to find. Mayonnaise just isn't the same. Why not make your own sandwich spread?
ingredients: 1 (16 ounce) jar creamy salad dressing (such as Miracle Whip®)
0.25 cup thousand island salad dressing (such as Kraft®)

steps.text: Place the pickle relish into a colander set in the sink, and allow it to drain for about 30 minutes. Mix the drained relish, creamy salad dressing, and thousand island dressing in a large bowl until thoroughly combined. Place into a 1-quart jar, and refrigerate overnight to blend flavors.
